_comment: The Codex variant (`dispatch.py … --harness codex`, docs/process/tower.md "Codex workers"): every phase on a Codex model, run under the supervisor in _dispatch_codex.py. Prerequisite: an installed, logged-in Codex CLI on the host (docs/SYSTEM-REQUIREMENTS.md). Before every start the CLI's model catalog is asked; a model it does not list is refused, never substituted. The variant is complete (default and tiers 0-3 name every phase), detached, without decision_channel or CLAUDE* environment; the Claude overlay model-policy.local.json does not apply. PROJECT CHOICES (model ids, time limits, context_sources) go into docs/process/model-policy.codex.local.json, laid over this file mapping by mapping. review_timeout_minutes / timeout_minutes: the supervisor's deadline per run. context_sources: extra repository files `rehydrate.py --codex` loads into a Codex session's context. Every model named here needs a class in model-policy.json `review_evidence` (ranks or families), or start refuses: attest.py ranks a reviewer by it.
